rosewood.fitNote: True to size, with a narrow toe box. If you have wide feet, go up half a size. If you have narrow feet, your usual size should fit.
rosewood.colourNote: Rosewood is a deep red-brown with a slight purple cast. It is darker than it looks on most screens, and not the bright rosy pink some photos suggest.

elliette.fitNote: Runs small: 70% of shoppers who returned it for size found it too small. We suggest half a size up.
